description: This file defines actions related to Zalo messaging service, including listing enabled accounts, describing message tools, extracting send parameters, and handling message send actions within a plugin SDK framework.

methods.name: function listEnabledAccounts(cfg: OpenClawConfig, accountId?: string | null) { listEnabledAccounts
methods.description: Lists enabled Zalo accounts based on configuration and optional account ID, filtering for accounts that are enabled and have a token source other than 'none'.

methods.name: describeMessageTool
methods.description: Provides description of message sending capabilities for a given configuration and account ID, returning available actions or null if none are enabled.

methods.name: extractToolSend
methods.description: Extracts message-sending parameters from provided arguments, specifically for 'sendMessage' type.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Handles sending a message action by reading parameters, invoking the sendMessageZalo function from runtime, and returning success or error results.
